difficultyRationale: Requires tracing a labeled continue that skips the remainder of the inner loop and advances the outer loop.
explanation: For each outer iteration, `j == 0` increments `count` once. When `j == 1`, `continue outer` starts the next outer iteration immediately. That happens three times, so the count is 3.

options.explanation: Exactly one increment occurs for each of the three outer-loop iterations.
The labeled continue prevents the `j == 1` and `j == 2` paths from incrementing.
Most inner-loop iterations are skipped by the labeled continue.
The increment at `j == 0` happens before the continue condition is reached.
